description: For Punjab in India, the University of Virginia Biocomplexity group provides a coarse SPW synthetic population. The Zenodo release is open under CC BY 4.0. Its README describes a ZIP with CSVs for persons, households, residence locations, activity sites and activity assignments, plus a separate contact matrix and validation plots. DHS household distributions, GPW counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places are named as source inputs. These tables could inform agent-based demand or service-access tests across settlements in Punjab. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this state release. A limitation is that assigned activity places are generated, not an observed origin-destination survey; using them for transport load or hospital demand requires calibration. The README does not document infrastructure networks or service capacities. The ZIP was not downloaded, and its population counts, field values and travel distances were not reproduced.
